heading_path: Part 13—Importation of goods infringing Australian trade marks
142  Commonwealth not liable for loss etc. suffered because of seizure
text: The Commonwealth is not liable for any loss or damage suffered by a person: (a) because the ComptrollerGeneral of Customs seized, or failed to seize, goods under this Part; or (b) because of the release of any seized goods.
